name: openbb_commodity_price
description:
Meant to give commodity futures price history (gold GC=F, oil CL=F, silver SI=F) through OpenBB (obb.commodity.price.historical).
Returns: {symbol, data_points, prices} when the command exists.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo futures symbol); start_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default 180 days ago); provider (default yfinance).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.commodity.price.historical, so the call fails with an error; use openbb_derivatives_futures_historical (provider yfinance), fmp_commodity_historical, fred_oil_price or fred_gold_price instead.
Example: {"symbol": "CL=F", "start_date": "2026-04-01"}

symbol.description: Commodity symbol (GC=F for gold, CL=F for oil, SI=F for silver)
